trigger.description: The steward has already performed the configured maximum number of auto-enroll reconciliation passes for the day (EE_MESH_STEWARD_RECONCILIATION_MAX_DAILY), so further drift reconciliation defers to the next day or an explicit operator run.
setup_commands: drive reconciliation until the daily cap is consumed
trigger.invocation: daemon steward tick, surfaced via ee mesh status --workspace . --json
